vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Omondi taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Omondi is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
🛡️ Atlas, Zuri, Theo, Laura and Omondi met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Atlas, Zuri, Theo, Laura, Omondi are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Laura taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Katarina has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Laura is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
